evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: 'Owned' vs 'rented' intelligence set in matched opposition.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Substrate-as-commodity and perspective-as-asset are metaphorical mappings; the two clauses set a deliberate contrast (commodity vs asset-you-keep).
